findings.claim: Ownership is decided by value alone, with no install-time record. If the user already had "agent": "foreman" before install-hooks (for example a hand-written foreman agent), uninstall-hooks deletes their key even though the overlay never wrote it. This contradicts the stated intent that only what the overlay installed is removed.

evidence: The diff shows addMainAgent writing only when the key is absent, and removeMainAgent deleting on an exact "foreman" match.
Nothing records whether the overlay or the user wrote the key, so the two cases cannot be told apart at removal.
I found no other defect in the diff. Whether every Merge path reaches mergeHooks is not visible in the diff, so I could not check it.
